verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs do not describe published, vendor-maintained SDKs. They provide an OpenAPI v3 specification and tell developers to generate their own client libraries from it, which is a developer building block rather than official SDKs. The client-libraries page notes that Yapily uses the same spec to generate its own server-side libraries, but no official client SDK packages are documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Generate API client libraries for Yapily in your preferred language using the OpenAPI specification. Supports code generation for Java, Python, Node.js, and more.
This is the same OAS that we consume ourselves to generate our server-side libraries
